capabilities.label: Planning
capabilities.gap: Plans are linear and re-derived per turn; there is no branching, backtracking, or cross-turn goal stack.
capabilities.next: Add branching only if a real request needs it; a linear plan stays the default.
capabilities.claim: Multi-step plans split on connectors, preview before running, and stop at the first failure.

capabilities.label: Tool use
capabilities.gap: Allow-listed tools are fixed at build time; adding one needs a table entry, a centroid, and a rebuild rather than runtime discovery.
capabilities.next: Keep tools allow-listed; document the cost of a new tool instead of adding discovery.
capabilities.claim: Allow-listed tools with deterministic routing, confidence, and margin.

capabilities.label: Long context
capabilities.gap: Context is bounded by named character caps and line summaries; there is no retrieval, embedding, or paging beyond the stored window.
capabilities.next: Measure whether real requests hit the cap before adding any retrieval layer.
capabilities.claim: Bounded long input, line-aware splitting, and named per-result caps.

capabilities.label: Compaction
capabilities.gap: Compaction is deterministic template summarization, so it can drop nuance that a semantic summarizer would keep.
capabilities.next: Keep summaries inspectable; add a field only when a test can pin it.
capabilities.claim: Explicit compaction with before/after bars and a reason for every dropped line.

capabilities.label: Self-correction
capabilities.gap: Repair re-runs only the failed suffix inside a two-pass cap; it cannot invent a different plan or retry a step with new arguments.
capabilities.next: Keep the cap explicit; a third pass stays a refusal, not a silent retry.
capabilities.claim: One bounded repair or resume pass from the recorded failure.

capabilities.label: Natural language
capabilities.gap: Language is table- and pattern-driven; an unseen phrasing falls back to the hashed router or refuses rather than being interpreted.
capabilities.next: Grow the checked-in phrasings from real misses; never claim open-ended understanding.
capabilities.claim: Checked-in everyday phrasings and short turns resolve to exact commands.

capabilities.label: Offline operation
capabilities.gap: The static tab is offline-first, but machine and socket tools still require the optional Python server.
capabilities.next: Keep the static tab useful alone; the server stays optional and documented.
capabilities.claim: The static tab runs the router, workspace, builds, and edits with no network.

capabilities.label: Inspectability
capabilities.gap: Inspection is per run and per project; there is no global audit trail across sessions or devices.
capabilities.next: Keep every claim tied to a named rule and a checked-in artifact.
capabilities.claim: Every run, rule, limit, and decision is printable and checked in.

capabilities.label: Cost
capabilities.gap: The deterministic path costs nothing, but an enabled LLM adapter bills per call and has call and byte caps, not a money budget.
capabilities.next: Keep the adapter off by default; a money budget needs a provider contract first.
capabilities.claim: The deterministic path makes zero model or network calls.

capabilities.label: Reproducibility
capabilities.gap: Checked-in fixtures and seeds reproduce byte for byte, but wall-clock fields and host-dependent machine tools vary between runs.
capabilities.next: Pin every fixture that can be pinned; name the fields that cannot.
capabilities.claim: Seeded builds and checked-in fixtures reproduce byte for byte.
